propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container mid-review during landing bursts, interrupting in-flight code reviews before they can vote on the LLM-Review gate

the reconciler retry path is unprotected during shutdown (review_and_vote runs inline outside the graceful queue) while the webhook-queued path is protected, creating a live-lock where deploys kill reviews and the reconciler retries get killed by the next deploy
interrupted reviews emit no VOTER_ERROR, leaving the gate fully live-locked while all health signals remain green, defeating the monitoring alarm safety net

deploy deferral via an in_flight field on the existing /health endpoint delays recreation until in-flight reviews complete, bounded at 1800s keyed to the deferral episode to prevent timer reset during bursts
the deferral bound is keyed to episode not SHA to prevent defeat during bursts where TARGET advances every tick and would reset the timer indefinitely
AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT is counted for observability when the bound is exceeded or the signal is unreadable, with a new paging alarm to catch the previously-blind live-lock failure mode
